cues.text: Scope charity office, how can I help you?
cues.speaker: Female

cues.text: Oh hello. I'm ringing about the Dragon Boat Race that you're asking people to take part in.
cues.speaker: Male

cues.text: Oh yes, we still need a few more teams. Are you interested in joining the race?
cues.speaker: Female

cues.text: Yes, we want to enter a team but we don't know anything about it? Could I ask you for some more information first?
cues.speaker: Male

cues.text: Of course.
cues.speaker: Female

cues.text: I don't even know when it's being held.
cues.speaker: Male

cues.text: It's taking place on the 2nd July ...
cues.speaker: Female

cues.text: Is that a Saturday?
cues.speaker: Male

cues.text: No, it's a Sunday. It's a much more popular day and more people can take part then.
cues.speaker: Female

cues.text: Right. And where's it being held?
cues.speaker: Male

cues.text: ... at the Brighton Marina.
cues.speaker: Female

cues.text: Oh, I'm an overseas student ... Could you spell that for me?
cues.speaker: Male

cues.text: Yes, it's Brighton Marina, that's MARINA. Do you know where it is?
cues.speaker: Female

cues.text: I'm not sure.
cues.speaker: Male

cues.text: It's a couple of miles past the Palace Pier.
cues.speaker: Female

cues.text: Oh yes, I know it.
cues.speaker: Male

cues.text: You take a right turning off the coast road or you can cycle along the seafront.
cues.speaker: Female

cues.text: That's good. What time does the race start?
cues.speaker: Male

cues.text: Well, the first heats begin at 10.00am - but you need to register half an hour before that - at 9.30 and we really recommend that you aim to be there by 9. It's a good idea to arrange a meeting place for your team.
cues.speaker: Female

cues.text: Right ... And the race is to help raise money for charity?
cues.speaker: Male

cues.text: It is. We're asking every team member to try and raise £35 by getting friends and/or relatives to sponsor them. Every crew member will receive a free tournament t-shirt if your team manages to raise £1,000 or more.
cues.speaker: Female

cues.text: Oh that's quite good.
cues.speaker: Male

cues.text: Also we're holding a raffle ... every crew member who takes part in the race this season will be entered into a free Prize Draw.
cues.speaker: Female

cues.text: Oh, what's the prize?
cues.speaker: Male

cues.text: It's pretty good - it's a holiday in Hong Kong .
cues.speaker: Female

cues.text: Sounds great.
cues.speaker: Male

cues.text: Is there anything else you need to know?
cues.speaker: Female

cues.text: Could you just tell me a little bit more about the teams?
cues.speaker: Male

cues.text: Well, you need to have a crew of 20 people for your dragon boat ... and you then need to agree on who's going to be the team captain ... That would probably be you ...
cues.speaker: Female

cues.text: Fine. Urn, I've got a group of 20 people who are interested ... do all the team members have to be a certain age?
cues.speaker: Male

cues.text: Well there's no age limit as such but if you have a team member who's under 18 then they have to get their parents' permission to take part.
cues.speaker: Female

cues.text: Yes, that makes sense.
cues.speaker: Male

cues.text: It isn't dangerous but we do have boats that turn over in the water and for that reason we insist that everyone wears a life jacket as well and you can hire life jackets from us when your team arrives.
cues.speaker: Female

cues.text: What do you advise people to wear?
cues.speaker: Male

cues.text: Well, most people wear a t-shirt, shorts and trainers. I certainly wouldn't recommend that you wear jeans or boots. In fact, it's a very good idea to bring some spare clothes.
cues.speaker: Female

cues.text: OK.
cues.speaker: Male

cues.text: It can get quite cold and wet if the weather's bad. And there's quite a bit of hanging around especially if you qualify for the semi-finals or the final ...
cues.speaker: Female

cues.text: I see what you mean.
cues.speaker: Male

cues.text: Have you got a name for your team?
cues.speaker: Female

cues.text: Oh, not yet, no.
cues.speaker: Male

cues.text: Well you need to decide on one and then put it on the entrance form which I'll send you ...
cues.speaker: Female

cues.text: Oh OK.
cues.speaker: Male

cues.text: So if you'd like to give me your address ...
cues.speaker: Female
